resources.string: This tablet always keeps the original. Copies go to the places you pick.
Always on: the original stays on this tablet.
A folder on this tablet, an SD card, or any folder another app offers in the folder picker.
Files are saved as Inkwell / folder / document / notes.pdf, notes.md, transcript_…md and audio_…m4a.
Inkwell couldn\'t keep access to that folder. Choose it again.
This folder can\'t be written to. Choose another one.
Read your notes, transcripts and recordings on any computer at drive.google.com, including a work laptop. Inkwell can only see the files it creates there.
Connected as %1$s. Copies go to My Drive › Inkwell.
Inkwell stops copying to Drive and gives up its access. Everything already in your Drive stays there.
Connected. Choose Google Drive for notes, transcripts or audio above to start copying.
Files are saved as My Drive › Inkwell › folder › document › notes.pdf, notes.md, transcript_… (a Google Doc) and audio_….m4a.
Google\'s sign-in screen couldn\'t be opened. Make sure Google Play services is up to date.
Google Drive couldn\'t be reached. Try again.
No browser is available to open Google Drive.
Google only lets an app reach Drive once it has been registered. Do this once, on a computer, with the Google account you want to use (about 10 minutes):
Open console.cloud.google.com and create a project, for example “Inkwell”.
APIs & Services › Library: search for “Google Drive API” and click Enable.
Google Auth Platform › Branding: app name “Inkwell” and your email. Audience: External, then Publish app (or add your Gmail address as a test user).
Google Auth Platform › Clients › Create client › Android: paste the package name and SHA-1 below.
Back here, tap Connect Google Drive and pick your account.
Inkwell asks only for access to the files it creates (drive.file). It can\'t read anything else in your Drive, and it never stores your Google password.
Notes are copied 30 seconds after you stop writing; transcripts and audio as soon as they\'re ready.
Copies are made only when you tap Sync now.
Recordings wait for an unmetered connection before going to Google Drive.
Nothing leaves this tablet. Pick a folder or Google Drive above to copy outputs.
The last automatic backup failed. It tries again on the next run.

resources.string: Sync copies your latest notes to the places you chose. Backups are separate snapshots: deleting a note never deletes its backups.
The documents in the backup are restored into your library. Large backups can take a few minutes.
No file picker is available on this device.
